annotations.title: Save a brand, product, presenter or voice

description: Saves a brand kit, a product, a generated presenter or a stock voice to the library for reuse in ads, and returns its id. Free. Only generated presenters (described in words, not a real person) and stock voices can be saved here: a real person's face or voice needs the consent the person records at https://ugc.fans/library. A new presenter has no picture until its portrait is drawn there.

brand.description: product: the id of the brand it belongs to.

call_to_action.description: brand: what an ad asks the viewer to do.

claims.description: product: claims an ad may make about it.

description.description: product: what it is. person: who the presenter is, drawn from these words.

images.description: brand and product: addresses of product pictures, out/...

language.description: voice: its language, as a tag such as en-US.

logo.description: brand: the address of its logo, out/...

never.description: brand: words and claims its ads never use.

provider_voice.description: voice: the stock voice's name, from the speech models.

tone.description: brand: its voice, such as warm and plain.

url.description: brand and product: their web address.
